task: This is a synthetic newspaper-writing exercise using fictional reporting notes. Use only the supplied reporting notes. Write from the reporting snapshot as of August 17, 2026. Write a headline and a 450–650-word AP-style newspaper explainer using the new Ilex Pantry in Cormere to answer what locally owned means when a store operates under a larger franchise brand.

facts.text: The Cormere branch of Ilex Pantry opened in July 2026 under a franchise held by local owners Omi and Rella Doss.
The Dosses own the operating company and lease the premises; the national brand does not own this store.
Their agreement permits use of the Ilex name, purchasing system and loyalty program in return for specified fees and operating requirements.
The agreement charges a 4% royalty and a 1% advertising contribution on gross store sales, not on profit.
For a month with $100,000 in gross sales, those charges total $5,000 before rent, wages, stock and other expenses.
The store's opening budget includes a $28,000 initial franchise fee, which is separate from recurring sales-based charges.
The owners are responsible for hiring and paying the store's 16 employees.
The brand sets required food-handling and shop-presentation standards; day-to-day staff schedules are set locally.
The agreement requires stocking a core list of 600 products while allowing additional local products approved through the purchasing process.
The store may set most shelf prices locally but must honor advertised national promotions during their stated periods.
The brand reimburses part of the cost of selected promotions under formulas not supplied in the reporting record.
Omi Doss said the purchasing network made it possible to obtain deliveries that a one-store buyer might struggle to arrange.
Doss said, "The name gets us into a buying system. It does not pay the electricity bill for us."
Independent neighboring grocer Leda Vint said shared advertising helps customers recognize a shop but can make stores appear more uniform than their ownership.
Vint said, "Two matching signs do not mean the same person is making the wage payment."
Ilex's regional network includes both company-owned and franchised stores; this location's arrangement cannot be assumed for every branch.
The Cormere owners have not released net profit figures, and the reporting record contains no guaranteed-return projection.
The franchise has a ten-year stated term, with renewal subject to conditions rather than automatic permanent ownership of the brand name.
The storefront previously housed a carpet dealer and retains its broad loading door at the rear.
The owners plan a local-producer display, but no sales results for that display are yet available.

forbidden_additions: The national brand owns this store or fees are based only on profit
A guaranteed return, identical ownership at every branch or unrestricted local pricing
